_comment: Authoritative sector table for the TS2068 space trading game. Index is 1-based and doubles as the ECM art image index (see midjourney/system_art_prompts.json). Packed to 6 bytes/system by tools/build_sector_data.py.
_art_note: Subjects are composed for a 4:1 letterbox strip (256x64), the top third of the TS2068 screen. (1) Favor horizontal banding - ECM gives one attribute byte per 8x1 pixel strip. (2) Stay in the hardware palette: black, white, one light gray (white at normal brightness), and pure red, green, blue, cyan, magenta, yellow. No brown, no olive, no other grays. (3) Avoid gradients: the converter dithers to fake tones the palette lacks, and at 256x64 that dither is the same size as the picture detail, so it reads as noise. Name the colors in the prompt and put exclusions after --no, since Midjourney weights negations in the prompt body IN rather than out. Preview with tools/png_to_ecm.py --report --preview and watch the speckle figure, not just cells-exact.
art_style_suffix: retro sci-fi travel poster, flat vector illustration, screenprinted in four solid inks, every area one flat color with hard edges, no shading inside a color area, wide panoramic letterbox composition, bold graphic silhouette, palette strictly limited to black, white, one light gray, pure red, pure green, pure blue, cyan, magenta and yellow, extreme value contrast between foreground and sky, large simple shapes with no element smaller than one fiftieth of the frame width, composition reads clearly at thumbnail size --ar 4:1 --style raw --s 0 --v 8.2 --no airbrush, glow, bloom, gradients, blending, soft shading, atmospheric haze, vignette, scanlines, crt, halftone, texture, grain, noise, fine detail, intricate detail, stippling, hatching, photorealism, text, logos, brown, olive, khaki, pastel, muted earth tones

systems.name: Coriolis Gate
systems.subject: A city skyline in hard black silhouette across the full width of the horizon, a dozen tall blocks carrying large rectangular patches of lit windows in cyan and yellow, a wide cyan glow along the horizon, deep blue sky above

systems.name: Meridian
systems.subject: A vast white arcology filling the lower half of the frame, three enormous concentric ring terraces in flat white and light gray, one large official skiff in black silhouette above, pale blue sky

systems.name: Verity

systems.name: Tessellate

systems.name: Kestrel

systems.name: Ambergris

systems.name: Tannhauser

systems.name: Fenwick
